name: Bloodnium Multiplier
description: Everything you kill in the Tower gives x{{times}} the Bloodnium. Set it in Configuration.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Bloodnium
settings.help: x1 is the game's own amount. Covers enemies, Haters, Screamers, Treasure Tubers, mid-bosses and bosses. The game's own kill-streak, floor-travel and VIP bonuses still go on top.

patches.sql: UPDATE master_const_int SET value = value * {{times}} WHERE id IN ('ENEMY_BLOODNIUM_POINT', 'HARD_HATER_BLOODNIUM_POINT', 'SCREAMER_BLOODNIUM_POINT', 'TREASURE_TUBER_BLOODNIUM_POINT', 'MBOSS_BLOODNIUM_POINT', 'BOSS_BLOODNIUM_POINT');
